description: The Locations plugin manages a directory of places shown on a map and in lists. It owns three entities: locations, stored in buildfire.publicData collection 'locations' (app-wide), each with an address and coordinates, a description and images, opening hours, a price range, a star rating, categories and a list of app users who follow its updates; categories, stored in buildfire.publicData collection 'categories' (app-wide), each with a title, an icon and subcategories, and soft-deleted by setting deletedOn; and the instance settings document in buildfire.datastore tag 'settings' (scoped to this plugin instance), which holds what the control panel's Settings, Design and Content tabs configure (sorting, filtering, the map, bookmarks, the Introduction screen, the design and the location fields people fill in). The control-panel operations (getSettings, updateSettings, updateDesign, updateIntroScreen, updateIntroScreenImages, updatePinnedLocationOrder and the location-field operations) run in the control panel and on the server, never in the app, change only what they are given, and save the way the control panel does; permission and access settings (who may edit, add or see things) and the charging options are not exposed. Every operation is basic or advanced (its usage), and says in availableFor whether it can be called from a generated form as well as from code ("form" only when every param is a single simple value). Every single-record create, update and delete has a batch form named with the plural (createLocations, deleteCategoriesByCategoryId, …) that takes a list of up to 50 entries shaped like the single operation's params, checks and finds every entry before writing anything, then applies each one exactly as the single operation would and reports each entry's outcome. Basic operations name locations and categories by their exact title (case-insensitive), never by record id, and a title shared by several records is refused rather than guessed; each one that names a location or category has an advanced alternative, linked through alternatives and named with a By<Id> suffix, that does the same thing taking the publicData record id instead and refuses an id that matches nothing. Operations typed publicData, datastore, userData, appData or firebase are declarative: the call is built at invoke time from context.query with $params.* interpolation, so they have no counterpart in plugin.contract.js. Operations typed function live in plugin.contract.js under the widgetContract object (and, because every one of them has a control host, also under the controlContract object the control panel frame dispatches to), are dispatched by context.functionName, and take (options, callback). A Foreground operation (only the push notification here) asks the person watching the frame to approve it before it sends anything; on the server it skips that step and the MCP server asks the app owner instead. context.hosts lists every place an operation may run, and an operation may list several of them (at most one widget host, at most one control host, and headlessSdk): generic means pure logic that touches no buildfire API and runs anywhere; headlessSdk means it uses buildfire and is safe to run on the server through the headless SDK; widgetForeground and widgetBackground mean it runs in the app's plugin frame, Foreground when someone should be watching it run and Background when unattended is fine; controlForeground and controlBackground mean the same for the control panel's plugin frame. generic and headlessSdk run on the server and are exposed to the MCP; controlForeground, controlBackground, widgetForeground and widgetBackground are not, so an operation reaches the MCP only when generic or headlessSdk is among its hosts.

operations.name: searchLocations
operations.description: Finds locations in the directory, optionally narrowed by name, words, category, price, creator, pinned status or being open, a page at a time.

title.description: Optional exact location title, case-insensitive, for seeing every location that shares a name. Defaults to unset, which matches every title.

text.description: Optional words to look for in a location's title, subtitle, address or custom address name. Defaults to unset, which applies no text filter.

categoryTitle.description: Optional exact title of a category the locations must belong to, as listed by searchCategories. Defaults to unset, which matches every category.

subcategoryTitle.description: Optional exact title of a subcategory of categoryTitle the locations must belong to; only accepted together with categoryTitle. Defaults to unset.

priceRange.description: Optional price range from 1 (cheapest) to 4 the locations must have. Defaults to unset, which matches every price range.

createdByUserId.description: Optional app user, by id or email, whose own submitted locations are returned (the app's My Locations). Defaults to unset, which matches locations by anyone.

pinnedOnly.description: When true, only locations pinned to the top of the list are returned, in pin order unless sortBy is given. Defaults to false.

openNow.description: When true, only locations whose opening hours include the moment given by at and utcOffsetMinutes are returned. Defaults to false.

at.description: Optional moment at which opening hours are judged; defaults to now. Pass it explicitly to keep the answer deterministic.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Optional offset from UTC, in minutes, of the clock whose day and time of day opening hours are judged in (for example 180 for UTC+3). Defaults to the host's own clock, which on the server is the server's; the app itself uses the viewer's device clock.

sortBy.description: Optional order: alphabetical, reverseAlphabetical, newest or oldest. Defaults to alphabetical (or pin order with pinnedOnly).

pageSize.description: How many locations per page, from 1 to 50; defaults to 20.

callback.description: Node-style callback invoked exactly once with a page of matching locations or an error.

error.description: Populated on failure, including an invalid sortBy, page, pageSize or priceRange, a category, subcategory or user that matches nothing or several, and an invalid at; null on success.

result.description: Populated on success; undefined on failure.

locations.description: The matching locations on this page, in the requested order.

currency.description: Currency symbol shown with the price range.
